label: Some concrete individual exists at w and at every world accessible from w…, from actual grounded
meaning: The added premise closing the root horn. Weakens the whole-carrier well-foundedness of the unregistered necessaryConcreteOfGroundedContingents to restricted well-foundedness and replaces its Lean classical axioms with explicit excluded middle. The closing premise is not an independent derivation: given excluded middle it is equivalent to the denial of a contingent root (everyContingentGrounded_iff_noContingentRoot), so it must be defended on its own (#505, #545). It is not implied by the conclusion (STMT-NECESSARY-ROOT-CONTROLS). Necessity is accessibility-relative; no uniqueness, underivedness, simplicity, intellect or God.

strong_version_needed.82cfaf26-fc86-54ab-8328-9a7b2bdbbe21: Not needed for this endpoint. Asymmetry alone does not suffice (an infinite descending chain of actual concreta is asymmetric and rootless), but the weaker closed-collection condition does (registered strengthens, strict by ClosedGroundingRoots Control.limitGrounder): ClosedGroundingRoots.necessaryConcreteOfClosedRooted proves the same endpoint from the same premises with it in place of well-founded actual grounding. This interface is retained for comparison with its original proof path; the reduction establishes none of the remaining premises.
